research_summary: The research identified three distinct primary musical works titled '回家吧'. The most culturally significant is 'Kulumaha', a Bunun indigenous gospel folk song from Taiwan. Another prominent contemporary work was released by Wan Fang in 2020, and a more recent one appeared in the 2024 drama 'To the Wonder'.

works.title: Kulumaha (回家吧)
works.description: A spiritual song from the Bunun people expressing a deep cultural and ancestral longing to return home.

representative_recordings.context: Original composition by the late Bunun pastor.

representative_recordings.artist: Vox Nativa Taiwan (原聲童聲合唱團)
representative_recordings.context: Featured in the film 'Listen Before You Sing' (聽見歌再唱).

works.title: 回家吧 (Go Back Home)
works.description: An indie-pop song exploring the internal journey of returning to one's self.

works.title: 回家吧 (Let's Go Home)
works.description: Theme song for the TV series 'To the Wonder' set in the Altay region.

representative_recordings.artist: Zhou Yiran (周依然) & Yosh Yu (于适)
representative_recordings.context: To the Wonder (我的阿勒泰) OST
